title: Krateo Marketplace Catalog
description: Renders the marketplace catalog ConfigMap (the curated blueprint + operator indexes as JSON) for the portal to read in-cluster. The catalog content is baked into the chart; the only install-time tunable is the ConfigMap name.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected when this chart is used as a subchart).

configMapName.title: Catalog ConfigMap name
configMapName.description: Name of the rendered catalog ConfigMap. The portal reads this same name via its marketplace.configMapName value.
